scope: Prepare opt-in, label-free exact scoped-publication qualification views. Existing frozen consumers, scorecards, receptions registration/executable and windows remain unchanged; this module is not caller/hosted integration.
evidence: Caller must provide original full scope envelopes keyed by exact digest. Current v1 receipts store only scope SHA; missing full evidence => SCOPE_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE. Never guess a one-file map or manufacture an older public clock. Reuse verify_committed_scope for local immutable commit/tree/path/blob/file/document proof; original remote readback remains publisher attestation.
qualification: Scoped v1 only; exact receipt kind/batch/snapshot/state path/file SHA/Git blob/commit/verified remote commit/full envelope digest/policy and actual capture/persist/readback clock chain. Require cutoff<=issued<=persistence start<=completion<=actual readback<kickoff and actual row/counter/link consistency. Reject contradictions; select deterministic earliest valid scoped proof by clock then receipt digest. Legacy stays unqualified/descriptive even if early; later actual republication cannot become pregame.
order: Prove both website and linked lab qualification before any downstream rehydration/outcome access. Layer imports/calls no outcome resolver, HTTP, model or scorer. Zero qualified inputs produce only coverage/reason metadata.
privacy: Copied qualified private rows/bindings and aggregate reasons only. No actual private data opened in software implementation; no raw source/forecast/statistic/weight redistribution.
frozen_boundary: No original receipt/forecast correction, old scorecard rewrite, backfill, rec-half code/source/registration hash change, restarted window, promotion, scheduler/default/website/dispatch change.
remaining: Existing score_saved/score_saved_website retain legacy-inclusive behavior until separately versioned caller wiring. New publisher full-scope evidence persistence and actual hosted source/runtime acceptance remain subsequent work; this prepared layer alone cannot certify them.
authority: Authorized ongoing lab implementation and technical blocker repair; root one integrator/ledger writer, isolated owner and separate read-only reviewer.
